verses.english: This was said by the Buddha, the Perfected One: that is what I heard.

verses.pali: “Kodhaṁ, bhikkhave, anabhijānaṁ aparijānaṁ tattha cittaṁ avirājayaṁ appajahaṁ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
verses.english: “Mendicants, without directly knowing and completely understanding anger, without dispassion for it and giving it up, you can’t end suffering.

verses.pali: Kodhañca kho, bhikkhave, abhijānaṁ parijānaṁ tattha cittaṁ virājayaṁ pajahaṁ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā”ti.
verses.english: By directly knowing and completely understanding anger, having dispassion for it and giving it up, you can end suffering.
beings go to a bad place.
they never return to this world.”

verses.pali: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
verses.english: This too is a matter that was spoken by the Blessed One: that is what I heard.
